job.title: Chef de Projet eCommerce / SFCC - F/H

tailoring.headline: Chef de Projet eCommerce / SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) & Java Specialist
tailoring.summary: Techno-functional e-commerce project specialist with 5+ years of experience delivering enterprise platforms for global brands like Rockwell Automation and Shell. Expert in managing stakeholder relationships, backlog grooming, user stories, cross-functional delivery, and international team coordination. Certified SAP Commerce Cloud professional bringing deep expertise in agile delivery, requirements analysis, omnicanal solutions, and production go-lives. Serving notice period; available from December 16, 2026, with a valid German work permit.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

cover_en.subject: Application: Chef de Projet eCommerce / SFCC - F/H
cover_en.hook: I am writing to express my strong interest in joining VISEO to drive innovative digital transformation and omnicanal e-commerce projects for international luxury and retail brands. With over 5 years of professional experience leading enterprise platform deliveries at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring deep techno-functional expertise bridging business requirements and technical execution.

bullets.label: Stakeholder & Requirements Management
bullets.text: Acted as the key interface between business stakeholders and technical teams at Rockwell Automation and Shell, analysing requirements, writing user stories, and driving roadmap execution.

bullets.label: Agile Delivery & Governance
bullets.text: Led enterprise e-commerce platform delivery in agile environments, managing backlogs, sprint coordination, risk mitigation, and cross-functional team synchronization across international sites.

bullets.label: Platform & Integration Leadership
bullets.text: Guided complex build and run phases for high-traffic e-commerce systems, overseeing data integrations, API migrations, and PIM/ERP synchronization for global enterprise brands.

bullets.label: Go-Live & Quality Assurance
bullets.text: Coordinated rigorous quality assurance, release builds, and production deployment cycles on cloud portals to secure successful go-lives and stable platform operations.

cover_en.logistics: Based in Karlsruhe with a valid German residence and work permit, I am serving my notice period with a last working day on December 15, 2026, and am available to start on December 16, 2026. I would welcome the opportunity to discuss how my techno-functional leadership can support VISEO's clients.

tailoring.why_company: VISEO's commitment to driving digital transformation and delivering innovative omnicanal e-commerce solutions for leading international luxury and retail brands perfectly aligns with my background. I am inspired by VISEO's collaborative delivery model and eager to contribute my 5+ years of techno-functional project leadership, stakeholder coordination, and agile platform delivery expertise to your clients.
tailoring.motivation_short: Driving enterprise e-commerce transformation and omnicanal success for global brands through expert techno-functional project leadership, agile delivery, and cross-functional collaboration.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hello! With 5+ years leading enterprise e-commerce platforms and bridging business-IT teams at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I'm very interested in VISEO's Chef de Projet eCommerce role. I bring strong agile delivery and stakeholder management experience. Let's connect!
tailoring.email_subject: Application: Chef de Projet eCommerce / SFCC - F/H - Kranti Chavan
tailoring.email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

Please find attached my CV and cover letter for the Chef de Projet eCommerce / SFCC position at VISEO.

With over 5 years of professional experience leading enterprise e-commerce platforms, managing backlogs, user stories, and cross-functional international teams at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring strong techno-functional expertise in digital transformation and omnicanal delivery.

I am based in Germany with a valid work permit, serving notice until December 15, 2026, and available from December 16, 2026. I look forward to discussing how I can contribute to VISEO.

Best regards,
Kranti Chavan
